decisions.reason: Removing the landing-page audit workstream does not alter the active objective of producing creatives capable of achieving a CPL below ₹80.
The landing-page work is removed separately, while the same source explicitly establishes the eight-video, 45-second, 16-file creative package.
The landing-page removal does not affect production-input sourcing; the same source explicitly requires the creative scope to include footage, voiceover, and script.
